intro: Students pick from this menu, and each side quest earns the Field Geologist badge plus bonus XP. Each one ends with a short write-up or slideshow explaining the science, with photos as evidence. Set the number required per term and the XP values to match Dopps Class.
safetyNotes: **Safety notes for students:** take an adult on any field trip, stay off cliffs and unstable slopes, don't collect in national parks or monuments (photos only), and never look directly at the Sun.

quests.title: Rock Collector
quests.task: Collect 10 rocks or minerals, then identify and label each as igneous, sedimentary, or metamorphic, with one ID test each (streak, hardness, luster, fizz).
quests.proof: Photo of a labeled collection plus an ID chart

quests.title: Weather Watcher
quests.task: Keep a 14-day weather journal (temperature, pressure, clouds, wind, precipitation), then predict the next day's weather 5 times and score your accuracy.
quests.proof: Journal plus a graph of temperature and pressure

quests.title: Idaho Field Trip Guide
quests.task: Visit a geology site with family, like Craters of the Moon, Menan Buttes, Hell's Half Acre, Bruneau Dunes, or Idaho Falls' basalt riverbank, and make a mini tour guide.
quests.proof: 5 photos with explanations of how each feature formed

quests.title: Watershed Detective
quests.task: Map where rain falling on your house ends up, step by step, all the way to the ocean.

quests.title: Soil Scientist
quests.task: Dig a small soil pit or take a core, sketch and label the horizons, and do a jar test for sand, silt, and clay.

quests.title: Quake Ready
quests.task: Build a family earthquake plan and kit checklist, find two hazards in your home, and fix one.

quests.title: Shake Table Engineer
quests.task: Build a model building from toothpicks, marshmallows, or similar and test it on a homemade shake table. Redesign it once to make it stronger.

quests.title: Volcano Model
quests.task: Build a cross-section model of one volcano type (shield, cinder cone, or composite) with all its parts labeled.

quests.title: Fossil Hunter
quests.task: Make a cast-and-mold fossil with plaster or clay, or visit Hagerman Fossil Beds or a museum and report on three fossils.

quests.title: Geologic Time Walk
quests.task: Make a scale timeline of Earth's 4.6 billion years on a roll of paper or down a hallway, marking 10 major events.
quests.proof: Photo plus the scale you used

quests.title: Energy Auditor
quests.task: Track your home's electricity for one week from the meter or bill, find where Idaho's power comes from, and propose three ways to save energy.

quests.title: Water Saver
quests.task: Measure your family's water use for 3 days by timing showers and counting flushes, then try a reduction plan for 3 more days.

quests.title: Moon Tracker
quests.task: Sketch the Moon at the same time every night for 2 to 4 weeks and label each phase.

quests.title: Night Sky Navigator
quests.task: Find and photograph or sketch 3 constellations, one planet, and the North Star from a dark spot.

quests.title: Science Communicator
quests.task: Make a 60-second video teaching one Key Word or concept from any chapter, aimed at a 5th grader.
